run.environment: Frozen commit; local Playwright plus connected Maestri Portals against real Astro, Vite, Bun/Elysia, and a unique disposable PostgreSQL cluster per run
run.data_mode: Synthetic workspace, identity, commercial, campaign, and intake fixtures; fresh empty PostgreSQL migrated through 0021 per run
limitations: Tenant isolation is not applicable because the product has a workspace-global access model and no tenant model; anonymous, member, admin, and disabled-user boundaries were tested instead.
Astro Dev Toolbar emitted a development-only audit Failed to fetch message during campaign document replacement; product page console, pageerror, and failed-request collectors remained clean.
Heavy Playwright and Portal image artifacts are local and ignored; the immutable report records safe paths and aggregate-only evidence.

out_of_scope: Tenant isolation because no tenant model exists

journeys.name: Campaign resolution, permanent and temporary failures, consent-gated analytics, responsive navigation, keyboard, and reduced motion
evidence: Active link resolved with replace history; inactive, expired, and invalid UX was indistinguishable; temporary failure recovered through retry.
Analytics requests were absent before consent and after essential-only, and privacy-safe analytics initialized only after opt-in.

journeys.name: Submit the visible public intake form and verify persistence after reload
evidence: Real API returned 201; aggregate-only evidence remained deliveries=1 and leads=1 after reload without payload or PII output.

journeys.name: Migrate empty PostgreSQL through 0021 and distinguish liveness from readiness during outage and recovery
evidence: Migrations 0000-0021 completed before fixtures; health stayed 200, readiness changed to 503 during owned database outage and recovered to 200.

journeys.persona: admin, member, disabled user, and anonymous user
journeys.name: Real sign-in, invitation lifecycle, guards, overview, profile, administration, refresh, logout, and disabled-user boundary
evidence: Better Auth sign-in and private cookies drove browser sessions; invitation signup and role boundaries survived refresh.
Anonymous deep links had no private-content flicker; member and disabled-user restrictions were enforced.

journeys.name: Lead, activity, configured-field, and today-queue lifecycles including recovery and responsive states
evidence: C1 covered create, list/Kanban, search/filter/history, detail, stage, archive/restore, pagination, and stale-version 409.
C2 covered activity lifecycle and audio boundary; C3 completed and dismissed flat work-queue actions with aggregate activities=1, finishedActions=2, pendingActions=0.

journeys.name: Connector RBAC and complete admin connector lifecycle
evidence: Anonymous API returned 401; member UI exposed no connector heading, tabs, list, counts, queries, or cached data and direct API returned 403.
Admin created, configured, mapped, activated, tested delivery to Processado, proved signed idempotency, and rotated the secret without exposing it or raw payload.
Aggregate-only evidence: connectors=1, activeConnectors=1, processedDeliveries=2, deliveryBackedLeads=2, rawPayloadColumns=0.

screenshots.checkpoint: Campaign and analytics desktop/mobile collection (10 images in each final run)
observations: Consent, navigation, active destination, permanent states, and temporary retry were readable and unclipped.

screenshots.checkpoint: Public intake empty, success, mobile success, and post-reload states (4 images per run)
observations: Form and success states were stable, readable, and free of exposed fixture values in the report.

screenshots.checkpoint: Identity and workspace collection (7 images per run)
observations: Login, overview, invitation, profile, guard, and denied administration states fit desktop and mobile viewports.

screenshots.checkpoint: Commercial lead, activity, field, queue, mobile, and 200% collection (6 images per run)
observations: Kanban/list, details, fields, history, and today queue remained operable without horizontal loss at required viewports.

screenshots.checkpoint: Connector configured, processed delivery, safe rotation, and member denied states (4 images per run)
observations: Admin lifecycle and Processado state were legible; member denial exposed no connector data; rotation screenshot contained no secret.

screenshots.artifact: Maestri Portals: Initiative 18 Desktop and Initiative 18 Mobile
observations: Accessibility snapshots exposed semantic headings, links, labels, and buttons; Portal log buffers remained empty; rendered site and login pixels were inspected.

access_checks.vector: Private web deep links and connector API
access_checks.evidence: Private routes redirected without private-content flicker and connector API returned 401.
UI denied access without connector queries/cache/list/counts and direct connector API requests returned 403.
Admin could manage invitation/users and complete the connector lifecycle through UI and real API.
Disabled identity could not retain private access; the synthetic user was reactivated only for subsequent bounded checks.

evidence: Focused 3/3 gate and both final 6/6 runs passed on 9a7589618d16660e5a170c265f6e5863b98cb71a.

evidence: Noise was limited to the Astro development toolbar; product console, pageerror, and failed-request collectors were clean.

verification.evidence: All 31 run-2 Playwright screenshots and representative run-1 artifacts were inspected; connected desktop/mobile Portal snapshots and pixels were inspected; Portal logs and product collectors were clean.
